environment: Stable local production preview; isolated headless Chromium session; synthetic one-flight fixture; read-only interactions

passportView.method: Five Stamps-to-Map-to-Stamps cycles; performance.now() from click until selected radio and view content are present; Resource Timing for matching Next RSC request.

passportLocalControls.method: Five cycles through Countries, Routes, Frequency on the real one-route projection; click until checked radio and route-list row count agree.
passportLocalControls.sortControl: Three stamp sort choices (Recent, Most visits, A–Z) were measured in browser-before.json. No separate catalog sort or type control is present in the add-country sheet.

passportCatalog.note: Selection timing includes the add-sheet exit before the detail sheet appears; no country was added or changed.

journalBoundary.directPage2: Rendered 'There are no flights on this page.' with Back to the first page link.
journalBoundary.searchEnter: Search submitted a no-match query while focus stayed on the input, not the H1.
journalBoundary.clearEnter: Filling the search with whitespace then pressing Enter normalized the URL to /journal. Empty-string fill did not clear the value in this agent-browser session, so direct keyboard-clear semantics remain unverified.
journalBoundary.unmeasured: Actual populated last-page Prev/Next behavior requires a multi-page fixture; none was used in this read-only supplement.

cache.documentedClearMechanism: No cache-clear command found in agent-browser core docs or CLI help. Named sessions have independent caches; a fresh session is the supported cold-browser method.
cache.resourceEvidence: A fresh journal document navigation in this session transferred all 24 observed JavaScript chunks (188,091 transfer bytes; 729,179 decoded bytes), including a largest chunk of 143,183 transfer bytes. This confirms cold chunk transfer after direct navigation; it does not establish a 300 KB transfer in the root's different route/session.
cache.stateLoad: Core docs describe state load as restoring cookies/storage. No evidence that state load itself requests application chunks; opening the first authenticated page does.
